title: Sabre to Host Investor Day on November 17, 2026
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Sabre's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
# Release Details


## Sabre to Host Investor Day on November 17, 2026


09/16/2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.sabre.com/node/20131/pdf)


SOUTHLAKE, Texas


, Sept. 16, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Sabre Corporation ("Sabre") (NASDAQ: SABR), a leading global travel technology company, today announced that it will host an Investor Day in New York City on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, starting at 8:30 a.m. ET.


Sabre President and CEO Kurt Ekert, CFO Mike Randolfi, and other members of the senior leadership team will provide an in-depth review of the company's strategy, growth opportunities, and multi-year financial outlook. The presentations will highlight Sabre's position at the center of the evolving travel ecosystem, how AI is reshaping the travel industry and expanding Sabre's opportunity, and the company's strategy to drive long-term growth and shareholder value.


The event will include formal presentations by and multiple Q&A sessions with members of the senior leadership team.


A live webcast and replay of the event, along with supporting materials, will be available on the day of the event through the Sabre Investor Relations website at[investors.sabre.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4775506-1&h=926422879&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.sabre.com%2F&a=investors.sabre.com) . A replay of the event will also be available on the website for at least 90 days following the event. Questions about the event should be directed tosabre.investorrelations@sabre.com


**About Sabre**


**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world's largest travel data clouds. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide. Sabre is built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture and serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. For more information visit[www.sabre.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4775506-1&h=347971191&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sabre.com%2F&a=www.sabre.com) .


**Website Information**


Sabre routinely posts important information for investors on the Investor Relations section of its website,[investors.sabre.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4775506-1&h=926422879&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.sabre.com%2F&a=investors.sabre.com) , on its LinkedIn account, and on its X account, @Sabre_Corp. The Company intends to use the Investor Relations section of its website, its LinkedIn account, and its X account as a means of disclosing material, non-public information and for complying with disclosure obligations under Regulation FD. Accordingly, investors should monitor the Investor Relations section of Sabre's website, its LinkedIn account and its X account, in addition to following its press releases, SEC filings, public conference calls, presentations and webcasts. The information contained on, or that may be accessed through, Sabre's website, its LinkedIn account or its X account is not incorporated by reference into, and is not a part of, this document.
